records.name: Goalkeeper
records.description: Traditional shot-stopper prioritizing goal-line positioning and box command.
records.tacticalBehavior: Holds conservative penalty-area positioning with minimal build-up risk.
records.attackingBehavior: Offers standard short back-pass relief without stepping high.
records.defensiveBehavior: Stays near goal line to maximize shot-stopping angles.
records.sourceReference: EA FC 26 Pitch Notes & FUTBIN Roles

records.name: Sweeper Keeper
records.description: Proactively leaves the line to sweep through balls behind high defensive lines.
records.tacticalBehavior: Operates higher toward the edge of the penalty area out of possession.
records.attackingBehavior: Supports quick restarts and distribution into midfield channels.
records.defensiveBehavior: Intercepts balls played behind a high backline.
records.sourceReference: EA FC 26 Pitch Notes & FUTBIN Roles

records.name: Ball-Playing Keeper
records.description: FC 26 addition: steps up toward the edge of the defensive third in possession to act as an extra build-up passing outlet.
records.tacticalBehavior: Pushes higher during possession to help bypass high presses while staying conservative defensively.
records.attackingBehavior: Creates a +1 numerical overload in first-phase build-up.
records.defensiveBehavior: Recovers toward goal line when possession is lost; vulnerable to immediate turnovers.
records.sourceReference: EA FC 26 Gameplay Deep Dive Pitch Notes

records.name: Defender
records.description: No-nonsense central defender focused on holding the defensive line and protecting central space.
records.tacticalBehavior: Maintains horizontal compactness with defensive partners.
records.attackingBehavior: Stays deep as rest-defense cover with safe short passing.
records.defensiveBehavior: Holds line discipline and marks central strikers.
records.sourceReference: EA FC 26 Pitch Notes & FUTBIN Roles

records.name: Stopper
records.description: Steps out aggressively from the backline to disrupt receivers and win early duels.
records.tacticalBehavior: Front-foot central defending stepping into midfield zones.
records.attackingBehavior: Steps slightly higher during sustained spells to recycle possession.
records.defensiveBehavior: Breaks out of the line to intercept or challenge ball carriers early.
records.sourceReference: EA FC 26 Pitch Notes & FUTBIN Roles

records.name: Ball-Playing Defender
records.description: Comfortable carrying and passing through the first pressing line from central defense.
records.tacticalBehavior: Splits wider or steps forward in possession to open passing lanes.
records.attackingBehavior: Initiates progressive vertical passes into midfield or channels.
records.defensiveBehavior: Maintains central cover with optional aggressive stepping.
records.sourceReference: EA FC 26 Pitch Notes & FUTBIN Roles

records.name: Wide Back
records.description: FC 26 addition: centre-back who shifts into wide channels to cover advanced wingbacks or form an asymmetric back three.
records.tacticalBehavior: Operates comfortably in outer channels, ideal for back-three or asymmetric back-four systems.
records.attackingBehavior: Provides wide progression angle behind advancing wingbacks or wide midfielders.
records.defensiveBehavior: Covers flank transitions and defends 1v1 in wide areas.
records.sourceReference: EA FC 26 Gameplay Deep Dive Pitch Notes

records.name: Fullback
records.description: Traditional wide defender prioritizing flank security with measured attacking support.
records.tacticalBehavior: Balances touchline protection with selective overlapping runs.
records.attackingBehavior: Supports wide build-up without abandoning rest-defense cover.
records.defensiveBehavior: Tracks opposing wingers and protects the back post.
records.sourceReference: EA FC 26 Pitch Notes & FUTBIN Roles

records.name: Wingback
records.description: Dynamic wide defender providing touchline width in possession while recovering into the backline.
records.tacticalBehavior: Stretches opposition horizontally down the flank.
records.attackingBehavior: Pushes into midfield and final-third wide zones to deliver crosses.
records.defensiveBehavior: Sprints back to restore back-four or back-five compactness.
records.sourceReference: EA FC 26 Pitch Notes & FUTBIN Roles

records.name: Attacking Wingback
records.description: Aggressive flank runner operating almost as an auxiliary winger in possession.
records.tacticalBehavior: Commits early and high along the touchline during attacks.
records.attackingBehavior: Overlaps wide forwards and attacks the byline.
records.defensiveBehavior: Leaves space behind on turnovers; requires CDM or Wide Back cover.
records.sourceReference: EA FC 26 Pitch Notes & FUTBIN Roles

records.name: Falseback
records.description: Tucks inside alongside defensive midfielders during build-up to stabilize central control.
records.tacticalBehavior: Inverts into deep central zones to form a double pivot in possession.
records.attackingBehavior: Provides central passing circulation and counter-press structure.
records.defensiveBehavior: Returns to wide fullback slot out of possession.
records.sourceReference: EA FC 26 Pitch Notes & FUTBIN Roles

records.name: Inverted Wingback
records.description: FC 26 addition: pushes high up the pitch and cuts into advanced central midfield or half-space pockets.
records.tacticalBehavior: Advances higher than a Falseback, overloading central attacking spaces in possession.
records.attackingBehavior: Arrives in advanced half-spaces or behind the forward line to create chances.
records.defensiveBehavior: High recovery demand; exposes wide channel if turnover happens early.
records.sourceReference: EA FC 26 Gameplay Deep Dive Pitch Notes

records.name: Holding
records.description: Central anchor shielding the backline and breaking up opposition counterattacks.
records.tacticalBehavior: Anchors Zone 14 in front of the centre-backs.
records.attackingBehavior: Offers safe recycling pass behind the ball.
records.defensiveBehavior: Screens central passing lanes and disrupts transitions.
records.sourceReference: EA FC 26 Pitch Notes & FUTBIN Roles

records.name: Centre-Half
records.description: Drops between the centre-backs during build-up to create a temporary back three.
records.tacticalBehavior: Converts a back four into a 3-2 build-up shape so fullbacks can push high.
records.attackingBehavior: Distributes safely from deep central defense.
records.defensiveBehavior: Steps back into midfield screen when defending deeper.
records.sourceReference: EA FC 26 Pitch Notes & FUTBIN Roles

records.name: Deep-Lying Playmaker
records.description: Dictates build-up tempo and line-breaking passes from deep central midfield.
records.tacticalBehavior: Primary progression hub connecting defense to attack.
records.attackingBehavior: Creates passing angles to switch play or feed players between lines.
records.defensiveBehavior: Holds positional discipline rather than chasing high.
records.sourceReference: EA FC 26 Pitch Notes & FUTBIN Roles

records.name: Box Crasher
records.description: FC 26 addition: defensive midfielder who bursts forward with late trailing runs into the opposition box.
records.tacticalBehavior: Combines starting CDM position with aggressive late arrivals in the penalty area.
records.attackingBehavior: Attacks cutbacks, crosses, and second balls inside the box.
records.defensiveBehavior: Slower to recover central space if possession turns over during a forward surge.
records.sourceReference: EA FC 26 Gameplay Deep Dive Pitch Notes

records.name: Wide Half
records.description: Defensive midfielder who drifts into wide channels during possession to cover flanks behind advancing fullbacks or create wide build-up angles.
records.tacticalBehavior: Shifts horizontally toward the touchline to support wide progression and protect flank transitions.
records.attackingBehavior: Creates wide passing relief and diagonal delivery angles from deep.
records.defensiveBehavior: Covers wide spaces behind overlapping fullbacks and guards outer channels.
records.sourceReference: EA FC 26 Pitch Notes & User Tactical Vision Matrix

records.name: Box-to-Box
records.description: All-action central midfielder contributing across defensive, progression, and final-third phases.
records.tacticalBehavior: Covers both penalty areas with high vertical mobility.
records.attackingBehavior: Supports midfield combinations and makes timely runs into the box.
records.defensiveBehavior: Tracks runners and contests midfield duels.
records.sourceReference: EA FC 26 Pitch Notes & FUTBIN Roles

records.name: Playmaker
records.description: Creative hub finding pockets of space between opposition lines to unlock defenses.
records.tacticalBehavior: Seeks free central and half-space pockets to receive on the half-turn.
records.attackingBehavior: Prioritizes final-third through balls and chance creation.
records.defensiveBehavior: Moderate defensive contribution; relies on holding partners.
records.sourceReference: EA FC 26 Pitch Notes & FUTBIN Roles

records.name: Half-Winger
records.description: Central midfielder or CAM who drifts into wide channels and half-spaces to create flank overloads.
records.tacticalBehavior: Bridges central midfield with wide corridors when wingers tuck inside.
records.attackingBehavior: Overloads opposing fullbacks and delivers diagonal crosses or cutbacks.
records.defensiveBehavior: Covers wide midfield transitions on their side.
records.sourceReference: EA FC 26 Pitch Notes & FUTBIN Roles

records.name: Shadow Striker
records.description: Goal-oriented attacking midfielder surging past the striker into the penalty box.
records.tacticalBehavior: Attacks space vacated by dropping strikers or pinned centre-backs.
records.attackingBehavior: Behaves like a second striker in the final third.
records.defensiveBehavior: Presses high around the opposition pivot.
records.sourceReference: EA FC 26 Pitch Notes & FUTBIN Roles

records.name: Classic 10
records.description: Traditional central playmaker operating behind the forwards with minimal defensive tracking.
records.tacticalBehavior: Stays high in central pockets to stay fresh for decisive passes.
records.attackingBehavior: Orchestrates final-third play through vision and close control.
records.defensiveBehavior: Low defensive tracking; leaves counter-press duties to teammates.
records.sourceReference: EA FC 26 Pitch Notes & FUTBIN Roles

records.name: Winger
records.description: Holds touchline width to stretch the opponent backline and beat fullbacks 1v1.
records.tacticalBehavior: Maintains wide positioning to open central lanes for teammates.
records.attackingBehavior: Drives toward the byline to cross or cut back.
records.defensiveBehavior: Tracks wide opposition fullbacks according to focus.
records.sourceReference: EA FC 26 Pitch Notes & FUTBIN Roles

records.name: Wide Midfielder
records.description: Balanced flank midfielder prioritizing midfield compactness and wide defensive discipline.
records.tacticalBehavior: Forms a compact midfield bank of four or five out of possession.
records.attackingBehavior: Supports wide progression without leaving the flank exposed.
records.defensiveBehavior: Doubles up defensively with the fullback.
records.sourceReference: EA FC 26 Pitch Notes & FUTBIN Roles

records.name: Wide Playmaker
records.description: Cuts inside from the flank into half-space pockets to act as an extra creator.
records.tacticalBehavior: Vacates the touchline for overlapping fullbacks while creating centrally.
records.attackingBehavior: Looks for line-breaking passes and combinations around the box.
records.defensiveBehavior: Drops into midfield shape rather than holding high touchline width.
records.sourceReference: EA FC 26 Pitch Notes & FUTBIN Roles

records.name: Inside Forward
records.description: Cuts diagonally from wide areas toward goal onto their stronger foot.
records.tacticalBehavior: Attacks the channel between opposition fullback and centre-back.
records.attackingBehavior: Primary wide goal threat crashing the box on far-post crosses.
records.defensiveBehavior: Less touchline recovery; relies on fullback or CM cover.
records.sourceReference: EA FC 26 Pitch Notes & FUTBIN Roles

records.name: Advanced Forward
records.description: Spearhead striker attacking space behind the defensive line and leading the press.
records.tacticalBehavior: Plays on the shoulder of the last defender to stretch pitch depth.
records.attackingBehavior: Runs in behind and finishes central chances.
records.defensiveBehavior: Triggers initial press on opposition centre-backs.
records.sourceReference: EA FC 26 Pitch Notes & FUTBIN Roles

records.name: Poacher
records.description: Penalty-box specialist focused strictly on finishing inside the 18-yard area.
records.tacticalBehavior: Stays central near the penalty spot with minimal build-up dropping.
records.attackingBehavior: Times sharp movements inside the box to meet crosses and through balls.
records.defensiveBehavior: Minimal defensive tracking; stays high as a counter outlet.
records.sourceReference: EA FC 26 Pitch Notes & FUTBIN Roles

records.name: False 9
records.description: Drops deep from the striker line into midfield pockets to disrupt opposing centre-backs.
records.tacticalBehavior: Creates midfield overloads and opens central lanes for Inside Forwards or Shadow Strikers.
records.attackingBehavior: Links play with one-touch combinations and late box arrivals.
records.defensiveBehavior: Screens opposition holding midfielder in mid-block phases.
records.sourceReference: EA FC 26 Pitch Notes & FUTBIN Roles

records.name: Target Forward
records.description: Physical focal point pinning defenders, holding up direct balls, and winning aerial duels.
records.tacticalBehavior: Acts as a direct vertical outlet under pressure.
records.attackingBehavior: Receives back-to-goal and lays off to oncoming midfielders or wingers.
records.defensiveBehavior: Contests aerial clearances and occupies both centre-backs.
records.sourceReference: EA FC 26 Pitch Notes & FUTBIN Roles
